## Venue

::: {.event-summary}
**Waseda University**  
Tokyo, Japan  
30–31 October 2026
:::

The Japan QCA Conference is an in-person event. The specific campus, building, and room are **TBA**.

## Access information

The following details will be added after the venue arrangements are confirmed:

- Campus, building, and room names
- Full street address
- Directions from the nearest railway or subway station
- Campus access and entry instructions
- Accessibility and step-free route information
- A link to an approved campus map

Please do not contact a Waseda University office about the conference until the organizers publish a designated venue contact. Conference questions may be sent to [jqca2026@gmail.com](mailto:jqca2026@gmail.com).
